invented: Signaling Tester would fit in the early R&D test stage, after implementation and before or during debug and validation
the cited workflow spans “implementation → test → debug → validation”
Its role is to act as the core test-system instrument for connected/RX-type testing
its role includes fading and channel emulation in early R&D
For advanced RF/FR3 work, the CMX500 OBT signaling tester supports multi-technology, multi-channel testing and adaptation to different NR numerologies
A signaling solution is specifically indicated “in case” it is required for RX test or other tests
